resources.string: Analysis runs with standard Android permissions. Deep clean features need Shizuku or root.
Using %1$s: cleaning Android/data, one-tap cache clearing, force stop and pre-installed app removal are unlocked.
Scan the whole internal storage for junk, duplicates and large files.
Read app sizes, cache sizes and when each app was last used.
Android blocks normal apps from these areas. Install Shizuku (no root needed) or root your device to unlock:
Read and clean Android/data and Android/obb
Clear the cache of every app at once, without tapping through Settings
Force-stop apps running in the background
Start Shizuku with Wireless debugging (Android 11+) or with a computer over ADB. It must be started again after each reboot.
Root is optional. SysClean only calls su after you tap \"Turn on root mode\"; your root manager (Magisk, KernelSU…) will ask you to allow it.
Restore or permanently delete cleaned files
%1$d items are never reported as junk
In a junk category, use the ⋮ menu on an item and choose "Never show this again".
Turn on Developer options: Settings › About phone (on some phones › Software information) › tap \"Build number\" 7 times. On some brands it is the OS version instead (MIUI, HyperOS, ColorOS…).
In Developer options, turn on \"Wireless debugging\" (Wi-Fi must be on).
In Shizuku tap "Pairing" and allow its notification. In Wireless debugging tap "Pair device with pairing code" and type the code into the Shizuku notification.
Back in Shizuku tap "Start", then return here and tap "Allow SysClean".
With a computer: connect over USB with USB debugging on and run the adb command shown in Shizuku.
Android 10 and older have no wireless debugging: turn on \"USB debugging\", connect to a computer and run the adb command shown in Shizuku. Repeat after each restart.
If Shizuku says "adb permissions are limited": in Developer options turn on "USB debugging (Security settings)" (needs a SIM card and a Mi account), restart Shizuku, then tap "Allow SysClean" again.
OPPO, realme and OnePlus revoke adb permissions
In Developer options turn on \"Disable permission monitoring\", then start Shizuku again and tap \"Allow SysClean\".
In Developer options turn off \"Flyme payment protection\", then start Shizuku again.
Rooted but not detected? Try anyway
Shizuku is used while it runs; root mode takes over when Shizuku stops.
See your health score, free storage and RAM without opening the app.
Your launcher cannot add widgets for apps. Long-press an empty spot on the home screen, choose Widgets, then SysClean.
